summary_en: DOE policy raised 4% to 5% for FY2/26–FY2/28 MTCP. FY2/27 dividend forecast revised: interim 76 yen, final 36 yen (post 1:3 stock split on 2026-09-01; pre-split final 108 yen). Prior forecast interim 72 yen, final 25 yen.
title_en: Notice of Change in Dividend Policy and Revision of Dividend Forecast (Increase)
translation_en_brief:
On 2026-06-30, Sanyo Shokai's board resolved to raise the dividend policy target DOE (Dividend on Equity) from 4% to 5% for the remaining period of the current medium-term management plan (FY2/26–FY2/28), and to revise the FY2/27 dividend forecast accordingly. The company cited changes in economic and financial conditions, and aims to strengthen sustained shareholder returns and improve capital efficiency.

Under the revision, FY2/27 annual dividend is forecast at interim 76 yen and final 36 yen (adjusted for a planned 1:3 stock split effective 2026-09-01; on a pre-split basis, the final dividend is 108 yen). The prior forecast was interim 72 yen and final 25 yen. FY2/26 actual was interim 69 yen, final 70 yen (total 139 yen). The split-adjusted figures reflect the company's intention to reduce the nominal dividend per share post-split while maintaining economic substance.
